# pricing plans

## Simple, scalable plans for businesses of all sizes

### Free

Build and test with live data using our core products

[Get started](https://dashboard.plaid.com/signup)

### Custom

Scale with volume-based pricing and support for regulated industries

[Talk with our team](https://plaid.com/en-eu/contact/#Enterprise)

## Free

Best for businesses and developers interested in testing Plaid

- Unlimited API calls in sandbox
- 200 live API calls per product
- Access to our API docs

## Custom

Best for businesses that need to scale

- Unlimited API calls in sandbox
- Faster SLAs
- Account management
- Integration assistance

### Is Plaid free for consumers?

Yes. Consumers can use Plaid to safely connect and control the financial information they share with apps or services at no cost.

### Can I try Plaid for free?

Absolutely. Our Limited Production service allows you to make up to 200 API calls with each available product using live data. This is the best way to start learning about and testing Plaid’s APIs.

### How much does Plaid cost?

Plaid offers two pricing plans in the UK and EU: Free and Custom.

- **Free:** Build and test with live data using our core products, with access limited to 10 Items
- **Custom:** Scale with per-request pricing and a plan tailored to your usage. Minimum spend and annual commitments may apply

For more information about pricing and plans, [contact our sales team](https://plaid.com/en-eu/contact/).

### Does Plaid offer discounts?

We offer volume discounts based on the length of your contract and/or the minimum monthly commitment you choose. For more details, please reach out to our [sales team](https://plaid.com/en-eu/contact/).
